description: This file defines an abstract base class for unit tests related to activation repartitioning in Orleans. It sets up test fixtures, manages silo addresses, and provides methods to initialize, reset counters, and adjust activation counts across silos.

classes.name: RepartitioningTestBase
classes.description: An abstract base class for Orleans activation repartitioning tests, providing setup and utility methods for managing silo activation counts.

methods.name: RepartitioningTestBase
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the test fixture and sets up references to silo addresses and repartitioner system targets.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by forcing activation collection and resetting counters.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Placeholder for cleanup logic after tests.

methods.name: ResetCounters
methods.description: Resets activation counters on both silos.

methods.name: AdjustActivationCountOffsets
methods.description: Adjusts activation count offsets to balance silo activation counts.
